channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: High winds on Thanksgiving caused power outages for nearly ten thousand Green Mountain Power customers in Bennington County. By Friday afternoon, crews restored power to most, leaving about one thousand two hundred still without service. The storm also led to road closures and postponed holiday events in the area.

A twenty-two-unit housing development behind Taylor Square in Rutland faces financing risks due to Act two fifty permit delays. Developer Tracy Taylor's loan extension expires at the end of twenty twenty-six. The city aims to gain Tier oneA status to exempt Rutland from Act two fifty regulations.

Wheels for Warmth raised ten thousand dollars for fuel assistance in southeastern Vermont. The funds will support people across Windham and Windsor counties. Southeastern Vermont Community Action thanks all donors for their generosity.

Vermont's weekly unemployment claims rose to four hundred ninety-seven last week. The state's unemployment rate stayed steady at two point six percent in October. The Vermont Department of Labor encourages job seekers to visit regional offices for assistance.
